title: comparative-evaluation: P0 research subskill 7/9 + control 24 (R07 needs >=2 alternatives, earned)
objective: Build the comparative-evaluation subskill: a concise SKILL.md that scores alternatives on explicit comparable dimensions, identifies dominance/non-dominance, and surfaces non-dominance rather than manufacturing a winner (a null recommendation is valid); a recommendation is epistemic weight, never authorization. Add control 24 (earned): a COMPARATIVE (R07) record carries at least two alternatives. Register IMPLEMENTED; badf-research stays DESIGNED (7 of 9 P0).
business_value: Comparison is decision analysis, distinct from gathering evidence; requiring at least two options stops a 'comparison' of one from masquerading as one, and allowing a null recommendation keeps the skill honest when the evidence does not justify a winner.
